title: Lantern Notes 3.8 release notes
brief: Please write the release notes page for Lantern Notes 3.8.0, released 2026-10-14, for the customer-facing changelog. Use the headings "New", "Improved", "Fixed", "Known issues" and "Deprecations". New: shared folders, where you can invite up to 25 collaborators to a folder and choose view or edit access for each; scheduled dark mode that follows sunset or a time range you set; and import from Evernote ENEX files, including attachments up to 50 MB each. Improved: search is about twice as fast, with the median query dropping from 410 ms to 190 ms on a library of 10000 notes, and background sync on Android uses about 18 percent less battery. Fixed: tables no longer lose column widths when exported to PDF; the app no longer freezes when opening a note with more than 200 images; reminders now fire at the right time after a daylight saving change; pasted web links keep their titles; dragging a note onto a folder in the sidebar works with a trackpad on Windows; and the word count includes text inside tables. Known issues: shared folders cannot yet be used with end-to-end encrypted notebooks (planned for 3.9), and ENEX import drops nested tags beyond three levels. Deprecations: Windows 8.1 support ends on 2027-01-31, and from version 3.9 the minimum Android version will be Android 10. Friendly but concise; users skim these.

edit.request: Add a fixed item "Pasted images no longer lose their captions", and change the search result to a median of 175 ms instead of 190 ms.
